notes.title: LAST HOPE FOR EXIT
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38643099/068712f0d1fed3a63f817c54384fb86c8d0bb70f.png[/img]
STEAM has ceased to cooperate with Russian developers, we will not be able to receive money from the sale of the game. We are not going to abandon the development, but you also need to pay for food, an apartment and a communal apartment in order to continue development and release a decent game, which, alas, in Russia you can already count on your fingers, we launched a crowdfunding company to raise funds for the development of the project.


Everyone who helps in the fundraising will receive goodies, a name in the credits, a copy or copies of the game, a beta version of the game, and much more depending on the size of the donation.

[url=https://planeta.ru/campaigns/leaving_russian_gamedev][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38643099/3dd71f27e2d14e97cb307e5e6d4a41b397c7c07e.png[/img][/url]

Since now there are sanctions, except for the Russians, no one else will be able to donate money, so all hope is only on us, I suggest not to give up, continue to live and do everything in our hands to stay afloat.
